# Gracie & Paul Irving

- [Gracie](../character/gracie.md) — Romantically involved with — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — courting · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> During lunch, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) recounts [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's misadventure at the brook, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to leave the table in amusement. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. After enjoying food, echoes, and conversation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head out into a nearby pasture to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her teaching term, leaving local mothers to gossip about her future and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and then Paul's home, where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully acts as a matchmaker, delivering Stephen's request and helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace
